metadata.chapter_subtitle: Measuring temperature and heat flux from emitted radiation

inventory.summary: The chapter needed clearer front-loaded guidance on radiance, brightness temperature, and surface temperature as distinct quantities.
issues: The chapter lacked the standard onboarding block.
The temperature chain from radiance to land surface temperature needed clearer early framing.
The specialist retrieval context benefited from stronger interpretive setup.

rewrite.summary: Completed a full editorial pass that added onboarding and clarified the different temperature quantities used in thermal retrieval.
editor_notes: Added a Before You Start block.
Clarified radiance, brightness temperature, and actual surface temperature.
Improved the interpretive lead-in to emissivity and atmospheric correction.

qa_review.summary: The chapter now introduces the retrieval chain more patiently while preserving the thermal-radiation rigor.

repair.summary: The conceptual-pacing issue was repaired during the editorial pass.
actions_taken: Separated the key temperature concepts more clearly.
Improved the lead-in to emissivity and atmospheric correction.

design_review.summary: The chapter's retrieval chain and heat-related applications now have stronger explanatory support.
improvements_made: Improved interpretive support around the conversion from emitted radiance to temperature maps.
